check_box.label: Enable AyaneStorm stars
check_box.name: stars_enabled
check_box.tool_tip: Uses the settings below. When off, stars are drawn exactly as in the stock viewer.

combo_box.name: stars_mode
combo_box.tool_tip: Procedural: random stars (stock style). Real sky: actual stars from a catalogue, brightest first, positioned for the latitude below.

slider.label: Density
slider.name: stars_density
slider.tool_tip: Star count multiplier. Procedural: 1 matches the stock sky (666 stars). Real sky: the brightest stars are kept; 1 draws 6660 (naked-eye limit), 3 or more all 20000 (down to magnitude 7.25).

button.name: reset_stars_density
button.tool_tip: Reset density to its default value

slider.label: Milky Way concentration
slider.name: stars_milky_way
slider.tool_tip: Procedural only. Adds extra stars in a band across the sky; the background field keeps its density. Greyed out in Real sky mode, where star brightness and positions come from the catalogue.

button.name: reset_stars_milky_way
button.tool_tip: Reset Milky Way concentration to its default value

slider.label: Brightness contrast
slider.name: stars_brightness_variation
slider.tool_tip: Procedural only. 0 draws every star equally bright (stock); higher values make most stars faint and a few bright, like the real sky. In Real sky mode use Magnitude contrast instead. Greyed out in Real sky mode, where star brightness and positions come from the catalogue.

button.name: reset_stars_brightness_variation
button.tool_tip: Reset brightness contrast to its default value

slider.label: Color realism
slider.name: stars_color_amount
slider.tool_tip: 0 keeps the stock star tint; 1 colors each star by its temperature (blue-white to red).

button.name: reset_stars_color_amount
button.tool_tip: Reset color realism to its default value

button.name: reset_stars_saturation
button.tool_tip: Reset color saturation to its default value

slider.label: Temperature (warm/cool)
slider.name: stars_temperature_bias
slider.tool_tip: Negative values shift stars toward orange and red; positive values toward blue.

button.name: reset_stars_temperature_bias
button.tool_tip: Reset temperature to its default value

slider.label: Brightness
slider.name: stars_brightness
slider.tool_tip: Multiplies the sky setting's star brightness.

button.name: reset_stars_brightness
button.tool_tip: Reset brightness to its default value

button.name: reset_stars_size
button.tool_tip: Reset size to its default value

slider.label: Twinkle
slider.name: stars_twinkle
slider.tool_tip: 0 keeps stars steady; 1 is the stock twinkle.

button.name: reset_stars_twinkle
button.tool_tip: Reset twinkle to its default value

slider.label: Latitude
slider.name: stars_latitude
slider.tool_tip: Observer latitude in degrees (north positive). 45 suits most of Europe and North America; the pole star sits this high above the north horizon. Greyed out in Procedural mode: real-sky settings only apply to catalogue stars.

button.name: reset_stars_latitude
button.tool_tip: Reset latitude to its default value

slider.label: Sidereal time offset
slider.name: stars_sidereal_offset
slider.tool_tip: Hours added to the free-running sky rotation; picks which constellations are up. Greyed out in Procedural mode: real-sky settings only apply to catalogue stars.

button.name: reset_stars_sidereal_offset
button.tool_tip: Reset sidereal time offset to its default value

slider.label: Magnitude contrast
slider.name: stars_magnitude_contrast
slider.tool_tip: How much brighter bright stars look than faint ones; 1 is physical (brightest stars bigger, faint ones dimmer); lower values even them out. In Procedural mode use Brightness contrast instead. Greyed out in Procedural mode: real-sky settings only apply to catalogue stars.

button.name: reset_stars_magnitude_contrast
button.tool_tip: Reset magnitude contrast to its default value

spinner.name: stars_seed
spinner.tool_tip: Procedural only. 0 picks a new random sky each time stars are built; other values give a fixed sky. Greyed out in Real sky mode, where star brightness and positions come from the catalogue.

button.label: Randomize seed
button.name: randomize_stars_seed
button.tool_tip: Procedural only. Picks a new fixed star pattern. Greyed out in Real sky mode, where star brightness and positions come from the catalogue.

button.label: Reset all
button.name: reset_stars_all
button.tool_tip: Restore the default star settings (real sky). Untick Enable AyaneStorm stars for the stock look.
